text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's lunch hour, and I'm taking a walk
after having
my meal when...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I've never really gotten much of a thrill
from it. I
haven't read that many either,
though.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's such a waste! There are so
many
suspenseful, exciting stories in this
world!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Trainer. Yeah. Books.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I never really find myself reading books.
Most of
my free time is spent with either
cards or dice,
y'know what I mean?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Wh-which means you don't necessarily have a dislike for them, r-right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I guess. I read the comics in restaurants'
waiting
areas sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see! That's a relief. You don't dislike
reading,
you just need to find the
opportunity to read.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I follow this one story about a hardcore
gambler.
There's a lot of turning the
tables, standing up to
cheaters, and
putting your life on the line.
choice_data_list: ロブロイにおすすめしてもらったら？

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So, you like high stakes suspense stories!
Then, I
have the perfect thing for you.
You'll love this
book!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Wait... You don't really have to—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
D-does that mean you'll consider it?!
Okay. I
promise I won't let you down.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
O-oh... You think? All right. I'll give it a
try.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Please, just leave it to me! I'll have it for
you
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If tomorrow's too soon I definitely
wouldn't—oh,
she's already gone. Does
she really need to get
that excited?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Phew... H-here... You can give it back to
me...
whenever... So, take your time...
reading it...
Mm...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...You look really sleepy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh... S-sorry. I was trying to pick the
perfect
book, and before I knew it, it
was already
morning... But, no matter. I
know you'll love this
one.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for training. I finish
checking
today's plan and am getting
ready to go when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The room suddenly goes quiet, and
Nakayama
Festa laughs.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"In silence, even a pebble can become a
deadly
weapon."
Haha. I totally get it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's nothing. Let's get going, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Just remain cool and calm. There's no
reason to
tense up.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"The man was caught off guard in a
moment of
carelessness."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hmph. I won't be letting my guard down.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"The corpse at my feet must be a sign
that there's
a trap here."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah... It would've been more exciting if
he
actually set it off himself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa is acting strange today.
Is this
because...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... No good. Maybe keeping it
calm and
cool isn't really what's up.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Why?
choice_data_list: もしかしてロブロイから本を借りた？

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's not like it's having an effect on me...
'Cause
it's not having an effect on me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But actually, you should read the book
too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's all about putting your life on the
line. There's
some thrilling stuff in here
you don't get to
experience in real life.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Like suddenly having to walk the fine
line
between life and death.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa seems to be completely
hooked.
She's much more influenced by
books than I had
imagined.
